Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane of a two-lane service road in Baytown, Texas, when Driver 2 moved left into the
same lane wtihout signaling and made contact with the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. The sideswipe was
witnessed by a pedestrian standing near the curb, who told me the vehicles touched as both drivers were moving at a
low rate of speed. Driver 2 confirmed the lane change and the contact when I spoke with him at the scene, and
photographs taken there show scraping and a dented panel on the left side of Driver 1's vehicle that is consistent with
the impact described by all parties. A passenger was seated in the front right seat, and both the responding officers
and the witness confirmed that person was inside the vehicle at the time. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and
said it was struck against the door frame, though it is not yet clear whether the injury came from this collision. No prior
damage to the vehicle was known to anyone at the scene. Driver 1 identified the vehicle as belonging to a
policyholder with whom Driver 1 lives, and Drvier 1 is covered as a member of that household. Driver 1 was
transported for evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- occupants_listed: How many people does the police report list in the insured vehicle (Vehicle 1)? The rating is a whole number. Allowed: a whole number.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
